premises.text: Fossil combustion still dominates energy and fails on efficiency, flexibility, and emissions
premises.evidence_span: producing up to 85% of our global energy demand through combustion-based power systems burning fossil fuels

premises.text: Solid oxide fuel cells plus CO2 separation and methanation in closed cycle remove combustion
premises.evidence_span: The heart of the plan is a solid oxide fuel cell module

premises.text: Design achieves full fuel conversion and about 80% electric efficiency
premises.evidence_span: achieve 100% fuel conversion and 80% electric efficiency

premises.text: Produces pure CO2 and water; reversible for power-to-gas storage
premises.evidence_span: On top of that, there is no off-gas anymore, but we just produce water and pure CO2

premises.text: Biogas plants use it for renewable power, CO2 separation, and long-term energy storage
premises.evidence_span: when there is not enough solar or wind power in the power grid, we produce renewable power from the biogas while separating pure CO2

premises.text: Customer economics: roughly 2x electricity revenue and >5x income with reversible mode
premises.evidence_span: they can overall more than fivefold their income

premises.text: Containerized units can scale across biogas fleets toward replacing fossil plants
premises.evidence_span: One single of our Revarium containers can provide up to 500 households with renewable gas and power

value.text: Carbon-negative highly efficient plug-and-play power plants
value.evidence_span: It is fully reversible. It is plug and play, and it even has a carbon negative footprint

causal_links.evidence_span: true game changer in power generation

notes: Global market-size ending treated as scale implication of P7, not a separate premise. ASR Ivarian/ovarian/Revarium left in spans where used.
